assumptions.choice: Approximate the weekly working timeframe by tracking elapsed calendar weeks as (current_date - start_date).days // 7 on the daily feed; rebalance/exit fire on the first daily bar that crosses each week threshold.
assumptions.reason: The harness fixes a single daily PandasData feed and I output only a Strategy, so I cannot add cerebro.resampledata; measuring 12/52 weeks by calendar-day difference is the closest literal reading of the weekly schedule.

assumptions.choice: Implement a single deterministic 52-week campaign (entry, 12-week rebalances at weeks 12/24/36/48, exit at week 52). The '50 random start dates', per-run storage of total return / max drawdown / Sharpe, and averaging across runs are NOT performed inside the strategy.
assumptions.reason: The output must be one Strategy class run in one backtest over one timeline; running 50 separate backtests and averaging their metrics is an external testing-harness concern that cannot be expressed within a single Strategy instance.

assumptions.choice: Use the first available bar (2020-01-02) as the start date instead of a random date.
assumptions.reason: This reference implementation is for an audit comparing execution traces; a random start would make traces non-reproducible, and a single backtest has only one timeline.

assumptions.choice: Model the 100% target weight as target_pct=0.99 of portfolio value, sizing each buy as value/(price*(1+commission)) and leaving ~1% headroom.
assumptions.reason: Market orders fill at the next bar's open and commission is charged on top; buying a literal 100% causes margin rejection (leaving no position), so ~99% is the closest faithful reading that keeps the position essentially fully invested.

assumptions.choice: At each 12-week mark submit self.close() (full sell of the whole position) plus a same-bar buy sized to the target weight of current portfolio value, both executing at the next open.
assumptions.reason: The spec models rebalancing as a full close and immediate re-open to account for trading costs; issuing both orders incurs a sell commission and a buy commission on the full position while keeping the re-open immediate.

assumptions.choice: Rely on the harness-configured broker commission of 0.001 (0.1%) applied automatically to every buy and sell; not re-implemented in-strategy.
assumptions.reason: The broker's fixed 0.1% commission already matches the spec's 0.1% per-trade cost and is charged on each order at rebalancing and final exit.
